finding: src/anomaly/workflow.py:509 The runner-owned README projector deletes every byte from the first `## Outputs` heading through EOF. Bound the rewrite to the generated outputs section and preserve unrelated trailing README content; add a completed-case restart/invalidation test with a journalist-authored section after Outputs.
rationale: The defect is reachable through the public restart and invalidation paths because completed P7 state unconditionally invokes a greedy Outputs-to-EOF rewrite, while neither case validation nor the tests protect journalist-authored trailing README content.

evidence.output:
run_product_workflow constructs WorkflowRunner and calls load_state; load_state calls _project_readme whenever the completed phase is P7, and completed-case invalidation calls it again. _project_readme applies re.sub(r"
## Outputs
.*\Z", "
", readme, flags=re.S), so every byte after the first matching Outputs heading is removed.

The case-tree preflight permits ordinary regular non-executable README.md content and imposes no heading-order or generated-only restriction. The PRD identifies README.md as the journalist entry point, so a journalist-authored section after Outputs is a valid reachable input, not an impossible precondition.

The completed-case restart test checks state, report, chart receipt, and event order only; the Gate-B invalidation test checks status/phase markers and preserved review/replay files only. Neither appends nor asserts preservation of trailing journalist-authored README content.
